faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RGNAU Junior Technical Superintendent post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application for the RGNAU Junior Technical Superintendent post is 15 November 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Technical Superintendent position?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Diploma in Engineering of three years duration in an appropriate field or a BSc or equivalent Degree in an appropriate field to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years. Age relaxation may be provided as per government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Technical Superintendent role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000/- per month for this contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Technical Superintendent post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Technical Superintendent post at Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC/EWS candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General, OBC (NCL), and EWS category candidates is Rs. 1000/-. SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process may involve screening/shortlisting of applications, followed by a written test, trade test, and/or an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU).

faq.question: Q9. What is the experience required for the Junior Technical Superintendent post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have 5 years of relevant experience in a laboratory in an academic institution, along with knowledge of computer applications and instrument handling.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. You can also visit the official website of RGNAU.
